product.name: Forge Loyalty Platform
product.description: A digital platform for restaurants to create and manage loyalty programs that enhance customer retention and repeat business.

product.name: Digital Ordering System
product.description: A system that facilitates easy digital ordering for restaurant customers and sales representatives, including AI-assisted checkout and order tracking.

product.name: AI CRM for Sales
product.description: An AI-powered customer relationship management tool designed to monitor and manage orders, customer interactions, and sales processes for food distributors and restaurants.

product.name: Catalog Digitization and Management
product.description: A tool to upload, update, and customize product catalogs digitally, enabling real-time price adjustments and personalized order guides for buyers.

product.name: Market Expansion Access
product.description: A service providing suppliers and restaurants access to a broader client base including various restaurant groups, franchises, and institutional buyers.
